notes: Algolia / React-InstantSearch listing on Next.js, same-origin on edwards.com. The ?country=Costa%20Rica filter is URL-addressable via the 'Select country / region' combobox, which performs a real navigation. Prefix /job is an explicit override: derivation from any sample yields the id-specific /job/<id>. Board paginates at 10 per page, hence paginate=True, and 18 matches the page's own 'Showing 1-10 of 18 results' counter. This is the board that motivated hooks.render_wait_sec: its first job anchor appeared at 46s, 50s and 49s across three trials, with zero anchors at 8s, 12s, 20s and 30s, so the global 8s settle had the matcher run against an unhydrated document and return a confident zero. render_wait_sec=60 clears the observed worst case by about 10s; 4 of 4 live runs return 18. It also motivated settings.navigation_timeout_ms: this board's load event is bimodal, measured at 51.7s / 2.9s / 2.2s / 2.8s over four samples, so a cold load exceeds Playwright's 30s goto default and killed the capture before the settle ran - the ceiling now scales with the settle instead of capping it. The settle used is recorded in render_wait_sec / render_scroll_count below, because a fixture captured at a raised settle cannot be re-derived at the global default. If this board ever regresses to an under-count the fix is a higher ceiling, or replacing the fixed sleep with a poll-until-anchors-appear whose ceiling this value becomes - the bimodality makes that the better long-term shape, since a warm load is ready in under 3s.
